zh.team1_bio:
Worked in Chinese news organizations for approximately ten years as a journalist and chief reporter, specializing in investigative reporting, in-depth interviews, and research into complex social issues. Developed extensive experience in information analysis, cross-disciplinary communication, and project planning.


Subsequently founded a media-related company, taking responsibility for business operations, strategic planning, and project management while applying research methodologies and information-processing skills developed through journalism to business practice.


Served as co-director of All I Want, a feature documentary exploring the relationship between humans and artificial intelligence. The film was selected for the main competition at the 2026 FIRST Youth Film Festival and nominated for Best Documentary Feature. The project further deepened an ongoing interest in the real-world applications of AI and its impact on human emotions, behavior, and social relationships.


Founded Senri Doufuu Co., Ltd. in 2025. Drawing on a background in investigative journalism, information analysis, and business management, currently leads the planning and development of AI agents, business automation systems, and customized AI solutions, while exploring more natural and meaningful forms of human–AI interaction.
